quarterly_data.quarter: Shibaura Mechatronics semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Six months to September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 42,277 million (+16.2%), operating profit JPY 7,572 million (+31.7%), ordinary profit JPY 7,369 million (+32.8%), net profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 5,317 million (+29.7%); semiconductors grew while FPD and distribution equipment fell. Segments: Fine Mechatronics sales JPY 25,853 million (+10.7%), profit JPY 4,480 million (+21.3%) - logic / foundry equipment steady and silicon-wafer equipment firm in front-end, FPD front-end weak; Mechatronics Systems sales JPY 14,108 million (+57.6%), profit JPY 3,371 million (+102.7%) - advanced-packaging equipment strong on rising demand for generative-AI GPUs, FPD back-end and vacuum equipment weak; Distribution Equipment sales JPY 1,397 million (-56.0%); Real Estate sales JPY 917 million. H1 R&D expense JPY 2,033 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 42,277 million (+16.2%); operating profit JPY 7,572 million (+31.7%); Mechatronics Systems sales JPY 14,108 million (+57.6%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Shibaura Mechatronics semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Orders, six months to September 2025 (semi-annual report): orders received JPY 41,156 million (+11.4%). Semiconductor front-end orders fell from the high prior-year level, partly because customers changed investment timing; back-end stayed strong. Fine Mechatronics orders JPY 27,518 million (+15.7%) - mask and silicon-wafer equipment orders rose, but logic / foundry equipment for the China market, unexpectedly strong a year earlier, fell and some customers changed investment timing, so front-end orders fell overall while maintenance / service orders rose and FPD front-end orders rose; Mechatronics Systems orders JPY 11,373 million (+21.6%) on strong advanced-packaging equipment for generative-AI GPUs.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 orders JPY 41,156 million (+11.4%); Mechatronics Systems orders JPY 11,373 million (+21.6%)
